replacement.sketch: No resource change required: Monoid laws allocate strings, numbers, arrays and affine functions only; there is no acquired service or cleanup boundary. Preserve the separate identity, associativity and concrete fold assertions.

No resource change required: generated maps/sets are in-memory values; combineNumericMaps copies its left map and AnnotationMap copies before updates. The reviewed combine paths do not mutate shared empty values. Preserve SentenceConcat identity-only semantics.

No resource change required: Token/Sentence/Document fixtures and codec effects are local in-memory computations. There are no resource layers; optional fields and filtered index lookups must retain their original expectations.
No resource change required: sample() constructs a fresh four-node graph for each case, and in-memory traversal streams are consumed in it.effect. No native service or scoped handle is acquired.
No resource change required: TextNode/TextEdge and annotation codecs are in-memory Effects; literal timestamps are data. There is no acquired layer, filesystem or external annotation provider.

No resource change required: the shared sample document and provenance are immutable test data; codec/link checks acquire no service. Span generation-link encoding is a deliberate assertion and must remain.
No resource change required: containment records, content wrappers and metadata are value-level fixtures. No ontology server, scope, filesystem or mutable service is acquired.

No resource change required: module-level len/inc/dbl builders contain pure Effect.succeed functions; production run/map/flatMap/product do not allocate external services. Preserve sequencing and both data-first/data-last assertions.

No resource change required: Pattern elements, marks and patches are local immutable values; codec effects have no service requirement. Original Option payload/tag and patch assertions remain essential.
No resource change required: path/module strings are data for normalization, not filesystem accesses. Query/identifier/path variant helpers acquire no FileSystem service and need no MemoryFS.
